Raising R14/R15 does NOT fix this with the worst-case Rout (alt_1k: Y2-pin tr 66 ns, IMU-pin tr 75 ns); only a buffer would. Accept, and confirm duty/edges on Y2 pin 3 with a scope at bring-up.

sensor_aaf.note: 24 kHz ESC PWM aliases to 576 Hz at 8192 Hz ODR (24000 = 3*8192 - 576) and to ~0 Hz at a nominal 8000 Hz ODR; with the +/-3 % internal oscillator the alias wanders anywhere in 0-4 kHz. The decimation-filter response (32 kHz) is unpublished and taken as 0 dB; tones within +/-1 kHz of k*32.768 kHz would bypass the AAF entirely and are protected only by the board filter (>= 24.1 dB there, sec 1).
sensor_aaf.model: assumed: AAF and UI filter each modelled as 2nd-order Butterworth (Q 0.707) analog prototypes at the datasheet 3 dB point; DS says 'AAF is a 2nd order filter', Q not given. The 32 kHz decimation filter response is not published -> taken as 0 dB (worst case).

sync.fifo_timestamp_note: DS sec 12.7: in RTC mode FIFO timestamps scale by 32.768/30; ArduPilot uses the measured sample rate, not FIFO timestamps, so no change needed.

clock_distribution.startup_note: Y2 start-up up to 5 ms; RTC mode must only be enabled after PD12 sees edges (ArduPilot IMU init is far later than 5 ms after power-up).
clock_distribution.R17_note: OE: 'enabled if logic 1 or open' (Y2 datasheet) - R17 10k pull-up is belt-and-braces.

spi.note: ICM timing (Table 6) is characterised at VDDIO 1.8 V and Cload 20 pF; at 3.3 V the output drive is stronger, so tVD.SDO 21.5 ns is conservative.

refdes.note: Analysis uses the frozen values/topology; capacitor refdes were renumbered by the schematic because C5..C11 already existed (VDDA/core decoupling). Values unaffected.
